deals.deal: BOGO Free Footlong for Sub Club Members
deals.desc: Buy one Footlong and get a second Footlong of equal or lesser price free on app or online orders; free Sub Club account required.

deals.deal: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
deals.desc: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink with any meal for $1 instead of the standard $3.99 dine-in price.
deals.region: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX & GA

deals.deal: 50% Off Small Nashville Hottie Quick Chick with Code LASTCALL
deals.desc: From 3pm to close through October 31, buy any Quick Chick and get a small Nashville Hottie Quick Chick half off online or in app with promo code LASTCALL.

deals.deal: $2 Second Protein on Any Salad or Wrap with Code STACKED
deals.desc: Through Sunday, November 1: double the protein on any salad or wrap for $2 instead of the usual add-on price. Enter code STACKED at salata.com or app checkout, or give it at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; participating locations. The code and dates are on Salata's own homepage.

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free: Free Kid'Zikis Meal with Each Adult Entree Through Halloween
deals.desc: Halloween week through Saturday, October 31: every adult entree comes with a free Kid'Zikis meal (grilled cheese, Child's Feast or Sneaky Taziki, plus a kids drink and a side) for children 12 and under, dine-in only, one per guest, no costume or account needed. Not available online; participating locations, so check yours. Announced by Taziki's on October 26.

deals.deal: $5 Regular Sandwich for McAlister's Rewards Members
deals.desc: Friday, October 30 through Wednesday, November 3: McAlister's Rewards members (free account) get any regular sandwich for $5, in the app or online with the reward applied at checkout. Reported by USA Today on October 28 from the chain's National Sandwich Day announcement; participating locations.

Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page.

deals.deal: Halloween BOGO: Buy One Entree, Get One Free (Oct 30 to Nov 1)
deals.desc: Burritos, bowls, salads, quesadillas and tacos: buy one entree and the second is free, October 30 through November 1 for Moe Rewards members (free account) online or in store; on October 31 anyone can get it in store by mentioning it at checkout. Listed on Moe's own offers page.

deals.deal: Free Kids Meal with Adult Entree (Halloween Weekend)
deals.desc: Newk's Rewards members (free account) get a free kids meal with the purchase of an adult entree, announced by Newk's email on October 29 ("THIS WEEKEND ONLY: Get a free kids meal!"), valid through Sunday, November 1. Participating locations.

deals.deal: Free Spam Musubi with Any Entree Purchase
deals.desc: Email-announced freebie for Pokeworks mailing list members (free sign-up) with any entree purchase through Sunday, November 1. Participating locations.

deals.deal: Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bowl, Chicken Burrito or 3 Tacos al Carbon with Chips and a Drink
deals.desc: El Pollo Loco's value combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, 3 Tacos al Carbon) come with chips and a regular drink for $5.99 to $6.99 at a Los Angeles store on order.elpolloloco.com, checked October 3, 2026. The chain advertised them at $5 through 2022; prices vary by market.
H-E-B's Sushiya counters repeat the $7 select-roll price on Saturdays at participating Texas stores. No coupon or app needed; selection varies by store.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.
Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations.

deals.deal: Halloween: 31% Off Online or App Orders with Code SPOOKY (Up to $10)
deals.desc: Halloween only: enter code SPOOKY at checkout on jamba.com or in the Jamba app for 31% off the order, up to $10, with a free Jamba Rewards account. Online and in-app orders only, excludes catering, participating locations, while supplies last. Jamba sent the code to every Rewards member by email on October 30.

deals.deal: BOOGO: Free Entree with Any Entree and Drink Purchase
deals.desc: Halloween weekend, October 31 and November 1: QDOBA Rewards members (free account) buy one entree and a drink and get a second entree of equal or lesser value free. The BOOGO reward is added to every member's account on Halloween; redeem in the app, at order.qdoba.com or by scanning in the restaurant. No quesadillas, no third-party delivery, one per customer.

deals.deal: Boorito: $6 Entree in Costume Today, 3 PM to Close
deals.desc: Halloween only: Chipotle Rewards members (free account) who come in costume from 3 PM to close get one entree for $6, in restaurant only. Announced on Chipotle's newsroom on October 20, 2026.

deals.deal: National Sandwich Day: $5 Medium Sandwiches for Schlotzsky's Rewards Members
deals.desc: October 31 through Tuesday, November 3: any medium sandwich for $5 with a free Schlotzsky's Deli Rewards account, in the restaurant or on the app. Stated on Schlotzsky's own homepage; participating locations, not combinable with other offers.

deals.deal: $5 Off Any $20 Order for Noodles Rewards Members
deals.desc: Through Sunday, November 1: Noodles Rewards members (free account) take $5 off any order of $20 or more on noodles.com or in the app. Sign in and apply the reward on the My Cart screen before checkout; not valid on third-party delivery, call-in or catering orders; participating locations. Terms are on Noodles' own offers page.
